Population change - Sex: all - Age: all.titleLong: Annual change in population - UN WPP
Population change - Sex: all - Age: all.descriptionShort: Annual change in population, calculated as the difference between population on 1 July of consecutive years.
descriptionKey: This is the *net* change in population. It reflects births, deaths, and migration combined. To see only the contribution of births and deaths, look at the [natural population growth rate](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/natural-population-growth).
Population change - Sex: all - Age: all.descriptionProcessing: We compute population change as the difference between the population in two consecutive years, using the UN's published population counts.
